name: Sprint columns
description:
1. Goal: make sprint board columns board-defined, editable, and sortable, where each column maps to a chat status and moving tasks between columns updates `chat.status`.
2. Store changes (`src/store/kanban.js`): `sprintColumns` now reads `board.columns` (with fallback to the canonical status list), plus new CRUD/reorder actions (`ensure/add/update/remove/reorderSprintColumns`) and helpers.
3. UI changes: `SprintBoardCanvas.vue` wraps columns in `vuedraggable` (handle-based drag), `SprintBoardColumn.vue` adds a drag handle + kebab menu (Edit/Delete), and `SprintBoardView.vue` wires events, an "Add column" button, and a dynamic default status.
4. Modals (`SprintBoardModals.vue`): new column editor (title + status, unused statuses disabled), delete confirmation, and a status-aware New Task flow.
5. Outcome: columns can be added, edited, removed, and reordered — all persisted via `saveKanban` — while task moves write `chat.status`; note that `SprintBoardView.vue` still needs to be mounted for sprint-type boards.

messages.content: Sprint columns will be defined in the sprint board and will be able to be sorted. We'll be able to add/remove/edit columns. Each sprint column represents different statuses of a chat and moving between sprint columns affects the chat.status property.
